features.name: Improved Critical
features.desc: Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19–20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.desc: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks; after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.desc: You gain another Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.desc: At the start of each of your turns in combat, if you don't have Heroic Inspiration, you gain it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.desc: Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20.

features.name: Survivor
features.desc: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws; at the start of your turn, if you are Bloodied (but have more than 0 Hit Points), you regain Hit Points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier.
